"Slow Hands" is a song recorded by Irish singer-songwriter Niall Horan, released as a single on 4 May 2017 by Capitol Records.
The song was written by Horan, Alexander Izquierdo, John Ryan, Julian Bunetta, Ruth-Anne Cunningham and Tobias Jesso Jr., while the production was handled by Bunetta.
It was serviced to US contemporary hit radio on 9 May 2017 as the second single from Horan's debut solo album Flicker (2017).
